info.title: RelayTale website API
info.description: Server-to-server gateway API and externally configured Webhook contract. Transport JSON/body evolution is opt-in; no implicit SMTP/inbox equivalence.

post.summary: Persist original MIME and an immutable envelope.
post.description: Server-side credential only; Origin/cross-site browser requests are refused. Test/production environment is fixed on the credential, never a request header. SMTP provider acceptance is not inbox delivery. Canonical deadline, stream, business association, envelope order, and exact MIME bytes participate in idempotency. Missing fields preserve the legacy fingerprint.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Persist before submitting. Reuse the same key and exact request after an uncertain result. Simulations have a separate per-message key scope.

parameters.name: X-RelayTale-To
parameters.description: One address per header occurrence, 1..100 distinct recipients. Repeat this HTTP header for multiple recipients; do not comma-join. OpenAPI describes a single occurrence; generated clients must implement repetition explicitly.

parameters.name: X-RelayTale-Expires-At
parameters.description: Whole-second RFC3339; canonical UTC. New requests must be after the database clock and at most 720 hours ahead. Exact committed replay still succeeds after expiry.

parameters.name: X-RelayTale-Tag
parameters.description: Repeat for multiple tags. See business reference documentation for the character whitelist and count limits.

schema.description: Exact original EML with CRLF and a final CRLF. Size is configured per deployment. No Content-Encoding or content-type parameters.

400.description: Malformed query, headers, envelope, JSON, or MIME.

403.description: Sender/stream denied, browser request forbidden, or sandbox identity required.

405.description: Method not allowed; see Allow header.

409.description: Idempotency conflict or per-message simulation cap reached.

410.description: New submission deadline elapsed, or inspection archive unavailable.

413.description: Submission size limit or 2 MiB inspection limit exceeded.

422.description: Deadline beyond 720 hours or malformed/too complex MIME inspection.

503.description: Operation unavailable or not confirmed. Retry writes with the identical bytes, envelope and idempotency key.

202.description: Gateway persistence confirmed; never an inbox-delivery assertion.

X-RelayTale-Environment.description: Identity environment; sandbox or production. Body environment/simulation flags are present only for sandbox responses.

X-RelayTale-Expires-At.description: Only present when an immutable absolute deadline was supplied.

get.summary: Query durable per-recipient state and a bounded event timeline.
get.description: NOT_EXPOSED means authenticated asynchronous feedback is not exposed. DELIVERY_UNKNOWN must never cause an automatic new submission. Sandbox event names express simulated observations; SANDBOX_STORED remains the message/recipient state. Events are newest-first; paginate with next_before.

get.summary: Describe a verified sandbox archive without rendering bodies.
get.description: Sandbox credential only. No query or request body. Verifies exact size/hash and root containment. 2 MiB maximum, 64 parts, depth at most 8, bounded headers. HTML, embedded EML and compressed attachments are never executed, fetched or extracted. Part paths and encoded/decoded sizes are diagnostic metadata, not antivirus or deliverability checks.

post.summary: Append a clearly simulated recipient observation.
post.description: Sandbox credential only. JSON <=512 bytes; no query. At most 100 committed simulations per message, independently enforced by the database. Replay returns the original event even at the cap. No SMTP attempt, delivery state, provider health/quota or suppression mutation. Old accepted/unknown facts are never manufactured.

post.summary: Receiver contract for a configured HTTPS website endpoint.
post.description: This route is on YOUR website; its URL is configured out of band, not hosted by RelayTale. Verify HMAC SHA256 over timestamp + a literal dot + exact raw body with a configured key, before JSON parsing. Timestamp must be within +/-300 seconds. Signature values are key_id:lowercase_hex, comma-separated during rotation. No bearer credential is sent. Persist event_id and raw-body digest before 2xx; exact duplicate =>2xx. Do not deduplicate by message_id. Events can be repeated or arrive out of order; mark dirty and query current state. Do not use sequence as a delivery-state version. Network dispatch is disabled by default. Sandbox events always carry environment=sandbox and simulation=true.

204.description: Notification durably accepted or exact duplicate already committed.

default.description: Non-2xx or uncertain acknowledgement is retried with immutable body bytes, within the configured gateway retry budget.

sendBearer.description: rts_ token mapped to an immutable stable identity/environment; never place in browser code.

sequence.description: Global int64 outbox ordering; not a per-message state version. Preserve as an integer without rounding.
